firm_data.firm_description: Herzfeld + Rubin, P.C. is a full-service, internationally-recognized law firm with more than 70 years of experience, headquartered in Manhattan’s Financial District. They are known for their commitment to advocacy and their dedication to working collaboratively and efficiently in promoting the best interests of their clients.
notable_facts: The firm has experience across the country and a reputation around the world.
Clients range from individuals to Fortune 500 companies and some of the largest companies in Europe and Asia.

email.subject: AI for Herzfeld + Rubin - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Wendy,

With Herzfeld + Rubin's reputation across the country and globally recognized work in toxic torts and tort defense, you're competing on complexity. That's exactly where precision and efficiency matter most.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your Manhattan office to share how we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw, especially in high-stakes litigation.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
